title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: The viewer is built to feel awe at images and music, dread of a calm machine, the slowness of space, and a confusion the ending refuses to resolve.

title: Hamlet
creator: William Shakespeare
summary: The audience is built to share Hamlet's doubt and disgust, to wait with mounting suspense for the act he delays, and to grieve the pile of dead.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
creator: J. K. Rowling
summary: The reader is built to feel the wonder of a hidden world, to belong at Hogwarts with Harry's friends, and to chase a mystery with a twist.

title: In Search of Lost Time
creator: Marcel Proust
summary: The reader is built to feel nostalgia, jealousy, and the sadness of time from inside, to labor through the sentences, and to share the joy of memory recovered.

title: Journey to the West

title: Little Red Riding Hood
creator: Charles Perrault
summary: The child listener is built to feel fear and suspense as the wolf waits in bed, knowing what the girl does not, and relief when the huntsman comes.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
creator: Agatha Christie
summary: The reader is built to suspect everyone, chase clues that almost land, be astonished by the solution, and then be asked to judge it.

title: One Piece
creator: Eiichiro Oda
summary: The reader is built to laugh, cheer, and cry: to love the crew as friends, hate injustice, and feel the hope of a dream chased for decades.

title: The Iliad
creator: Homer

title: The Metamorphosis
creator: Franz Kafka

title: The Shining
creator: Stanley Kubrick
summary: The viewer is built to feel dread from the first helicopter shot, fear in Room 237 and at the bathroom door, and confusion about what the hotel is.

title: The Song of Roland
creator: Anonymous
summary: The listener is built to admire Roland, dread the ambush he will not call for help against, grieve his death, and savor Ganelon's punishment.

title: The Tale of Genji
creator: Murasaki Shikibu
summary: The reader is built to feel the sadness of things: longing, pity for the women, aesthetic delight in poems and seasons, and unease at desire's costs.

title: Titanic
creator: James Cameron
summary: The viewer is built to fall for the romance, dread the iceberg everyone knows is coming, feel the cold, and weep at the door and the whistle.
